title: backlog.py stage-back ID copies, checks and commits a worker's staging copies, or with --check only checks them
goal: backlog.py stage-back ID copies the staging copies dispatch named into the worker's worktree, refuses a copy whose base differs, runs selfdoc.py check and the item's checks there and commits the copies alone with KB-Work on work/ID; --check runs the docs check over the staged copies and commits nothing

run: import subprocess,sys;p=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'_tools/backlog.py','stage-back','--help'],capture_output=True,text=True);sys.exit(0 if p.returncode==0 and '--check' in p.stdout else 1)

clauses.clause: backlog.py stage-back ID copies the staging copies dispatch named into the worker's worktree, refuses a copy whose base differs, runs selfdoc.py check and the item's checks there and commits the copies alone with KB-Work on work/ID
--check runs the docs check over the staged copies and commits nothing

gates.question: How does stage-back know the base a staging copy was made from?
options: dispatch records the digest of the worktree's file in staging-bases.json of the scratch directory when it stages the copy
compare with the file at the worktree's HEAD
gates.recommendation: dispatch records the digest of the worktree's file in staging-bases.json of the scratch directory when it stages the copy
gates.answer: dispatch records the digest of the worktree's file in staging-bases.json of the scratch directory when it stages the copy

gates.question: What does stage-back do with a staging copy that has no recorded base (made before dispatch recorded bases)?
options: refuse it, naming the file, so the orchestrator copies it back by hand
accept it when the worktree's file equals the file at HEAD
gates.recommendation: refuse it, naming the file, so the orchestrator copies it back by hand
gates.answer: refuse it, naming the file, so the orchestrator copies it back by hand

gates.question: What does stage-back --check run over the staged copies?
options: selfdoc.py check, and the list of stale docs without failing on them
selfdoc.py check and the item's own checks
gates.recommendation: selfdoc.py check, and the list of stale docs without failing on them
gates.answer: selfdoc.py check, and the list of stale docs without failing on them

gates.question: How do the session's own trailers (Co-Authored-By, Session) reach the commit stage-back makes?
options: --trailer 'Key: value', repeatable, written after KB-Work as claim and answer do
gates.recommendation: --trailer 'Key: value', repeatable, written after KB-Work as claim and answer do

notes: Orchestrator (2026-10-14): kb/_self/code.md added to the touches before the claim; a new import or facade entry in bl_dispatch.py and backlog.py makes selfdoc stale name it (as it did for TK-zqeq54ma).
